info.title: AnchorShell Relay Inference API
info.description: Public inference contract; this is not a software release version. Self-hosted Relay requires RELAY_API_TOKEN as a Bearer credential by default. An explicitly empty RELAY_API_TOKEN disables inference authentication; use that only in controlled environments. Use TLS for remote access. Management, dummy fixtures, and private service endpoints are outside this specification.

servers.description: Default self-hosted development origin; replace with your protected Relay origin.

post.description: Uses enabled candidates, scheduling and limits. Effective HTTP guardrails support non-streaming chat/responses only; guarded streaming or embeddings requests are rejected. Additional fields follow the configured provider, not a universal provider schema.

get.description: Returns upstream model identifiers for enabled configured endpoints. It is not a complete list of group call names or a global provider catalog.

200.description: Enabled model endpoints visible to the deployment.

InferenceUnauthorized.description: Missing, malformed, or incorrect RELAY_API_TOKEN. Management tokens and session cookies are not inference credentials.

relayApiToken.description: Use RELAY_API_TOKEN, not RELAY_ADMIN_TOKEN or a provider credential. Generated once on startup when absent; explicitly empty disables inference authentication.

model.description: Routing selector: configured group name/slug, model name, or provider/model. No separate route or endpoint selector is required.

content.description: Provider-supported text, multimodal parts, or null.

ChatRequest.description: Provider-compatible request. Relay derives wait, fallback, priority, token estimates, and cost limits from internal/configured policy, not per-request override fields or headers. Standard output-token limits inform internal estimation. Additional provider fields are forwarded, not interpreted as Relay policy controls.
